Tucker Reward is a native Android app built from your project zip. Banner stays pinned at the bottom, Interstitial shows on “Next Page”, and Rewarded video grants coins only after the video is fully watched.

Watch videos and browse pages to earn coins. Complete the reward video fully to receive your coins.
BANNER 320×50
AdMob • hides on no-fill
1 • BANNER

Sticky bottom bar

Loaded after SDK init. Hides itself on failure so content is never blocked. Lifecycle pause / resume / destroy wired.

2 • INTERSTITIAL

Pre-loaded navigation ad

Pre-loaded on launch. “Next Page” shows it, then navigates to NextActivity on dismiss. Auto-reloads for the next tap.

3 • REWARDED VIDEO

Earning task

Coins granted only inside onUserEarnedReward(). “Video not ready” fallback never crashes and retries load.

Build the real APK from this repo

./gradlew assembleDebug
# APK → app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
# Package: com.example.tuckerreward

Source from your zip lives in app/src/main (MainActivity.java, NextActivity.java, activity_main.xml, activity_next.xml, AndroidManifest.xml). This page is a static web preview served from dist/.

APK download: app-debug.apk (9 MB) If the file 404s, run the gradle build above and restart the server — start.sh auto-copies it into dist/.
